contract: FreightLens queue-first document workbench. Cool-neutral/slate/cobalt UI; New review native dialog; compact queue plus selected review on wide screens; fields beside source text; mobile detail with Back. Preserve human and current-policy approval gates. Contract and references: docs/design.md.

accessibility.evidence: Browser verified first Tab/skip link to main, selected heading focus, modal Tab cycling/Escape/opener return, local modal errors/progress outside busy form, named compact-rail controls and pressed source selections. Computed foreground/background text contrast has no failures on tested queue/review/dialog surfaces after fixes, excluding decorative/disabled content. Primary actions are 44px and secondary controls generally 40px. Reduced motion shortens transitions. This is not certification.

responsive.evidence: Rendered and inspected 1440x1000,1024x900,390x844. No page-level horizontal overflow in queue/detail. Wide screen retains compact queue; narrower screens give detail full width with Back. Native mobile dialog is bounded and scrolls vertically. Long carrier, filename, quote and unbroken source tokens remain contained on desktop/mobile.

loading.evidence: Held health response in browser route: stable loading queue and unknown counters, not false zero. Held upload: local progress, file inputs/close disabled, Escape explains that processing must finish.

empty.evidence: Fresh temporary SQLite queue has no records and offers Create a review. Actual status/search filtering produces No matching reviews; Clear filters restores the saved queue.

error.evidence: Controlled startup 503 displays Retry and recovers when route is removed. Blank upload and controlled provider 503 focus local dialog error; selected invoice.pdf remains chosen and usable after failure.

partial.evidence: Actual fictional FL-1003 has two documents, available fields/source evidence and a missing proof-of-delivery finding. Approval stays disabled.

success.evidence: Uploaded three actual clean sample PDFs, approved with name/note and completed JSON download. Saved a discrepancy note while keeping selected source document/field. Per-review unsaved drafts restore on return and never transfer to another shipment.

permission.evidence: Workflow boundary: actual earlier-policy review shows dominant Recheck required, disabled approval and hidden export. Current mismatch also blocks approval. Authentication/role permissions do not exist in this local prototype and are not claimed.
